feed.subtitle: Research papers and global crypto regulation, at a glance
feed.rights: Explanations and summaries are generated by AI from the original text. Dates, rates and amounts are checked against the source, but errors are still possible, so always rely on the original. Nothing here is legal, tax or investment advice.

entry.title: HKMA and Bank Negara Malaysia agree to deepen bilateral cooperation
entry.summary: Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Negara Malaysia Strengthen Bilateral Cooperation HKMA · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The HKMA and Bank Negara Malaysia held a high-level bilateral meeting in Hong Kong covering fintech, banking regulation, capital markets and Islamic finance. The two sides agreed to cooperate on fintech and digital asset innovation, cross-border regulation, local currency usage and infrastructure linkages, and capital market connectivity.

entry.title: SFC issues guidance to strengthen Hong Kong's retail fund regime
entry.summary: SFC issues guidance to support enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime SFC · Oct 28, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission published guidance to help the fund industry prepare for the revised Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds, effective 1 November 2026. The package includes circulars, FAQs and updated guides covering the Value-at-Risk approach to derivatives, liquidity risk management, money market fund requirements and transitional arrangements. Revised key facts statement templates with enhanced disclosure on product classification and liquidity risk tools were also issued.

entry.title: SFC welcomes launch of platform and nominee services on the Integrated Fund Platform
entry.summary: SFC welcomes launch of Platform and Nominee Services on Integrated Fund Platform SFC · Oct 28, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission welcomed the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing's launch of Platform and Nominee Services on the Integrated Fund Platform (IFP). The launch marks a key milestone in IFP's development and is intended to help fund managers and distributors streamline operations and broaden participation in fund distribution. From today, distributors including brokers can carry out fund subscriptions and redemptions on behalf of their clients.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong on sharpening investor judgement against digital fraud at IOSCO World Investor Week 2026.
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Keynote Remarks at IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 - Strike the Gong for Financial Literacy Event SFC · Oct 14, 2026 SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong gave this keynote at the IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 financial literacy event, hosted by HKEX, the Investor and Financial Education Council, CFA Institute and CFA Society Hong Kong. He argues that fraud now reaches investors through social media, instant messaging and artificial intelligence, so investor education must strengthen judgement, not just knowledge. He recommends three habits, practise, pause and question, and says regulators, financial institutions and technology platforms also share responsibility.

entry.title: SFC approves six securities registrars ahead of uncertificated securities market regime
entry.summary: SFC approves six securities registrars for upcoming uncertificated securities market regime SFC · Oct 13, 2026 The SFC approved six companies as approved securities registrars effective 16 November 2026, when the USM regime takes effect. Computershare Hong Kong Investor Services Limited and Tricor Investor Services Limited are also approved to provide USM-related services, making them the first batch to do so. Listed issuers of prescribed securities must maintain an ASR at all times once the regime is implemented.

entry.title: SFC Strengthens Targeted Tools for IPO-Related and Other Corporate Misconduct
entry.summary: SFC proceeds to strengthen targeted tools to tackle IPO-related and other corporate misconduct SFC · Oct 13, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has published its consultation conclusions on strengthening tools under the Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) Rules (SMLR) for handling IPO cases and post-IPO matters. The amendments would let the SFC impose conditions on listing applicants that continue after listing, and post-listing conditions on issuers as an alternative to immediate trading suspension, while streamlining resumption. A new independent merits review through the Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal is also proposed. The SFC expects the changes to take effect in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the legislative process.

entry.title: Julia Leung's keynote speech at ASIFMA liquidity conference
entry.summary: New speech by Julia Leung: Keynote address at ASIFMA’s Future of Liquidity in Asia Pacific Capital Markets Conference SFC · Oct 9, 2026 SFC Chief Executive Julia Leung delivered a keynote speech titled "Project Liquidity: Engineering the Market Plumbing that Unlocks Capital Flows for Hong Kong" at ASIFMA's Future of Liquidity in Asia Pacific Capital Markets Conference. The speech is posted on the SFC website.

entry.title: Hong Kong SFC hosts IOSCO committee meeting on issuer accounting, audit and disclosure
entry.summary: SFC hosts meeting of IOSCO’s Committee on Issuer Accounting, Audit and Disclosure SFC · Oct 9, 2026 The SFC hosted the plenary meeting of IOSCO's Committee on Issuer Accounting, Audit and Disclosure in Hong Kong from 5 to 8 October 2026. More than 35 senior representatives from 21 securities regulators attended. Discussions covered modernising disclosure requirements to reduce reporting burdens, new developments in financial reporting and auditing, and emerging issues such as technology, artificial intelligence and private equity investment in audit firms.

entry.title: SFC, AFRC and HKEX Issue Joint Statement on Disclaimers of Opinion Solely Relating to Going Concern
entry.summary: SFC, AFRC and the Exchange join forces to address disclaimers of opinion solely relating to going concern SFC · Oct 9, 2026 The Hong Kong SFC, AFRC and the Stock Exchange issued a joint statement addressing the rising number of listed issuers whose financial statements carry a disclaimer of opinion solely relating to going concern. The statement sets out expectations for management, audit committees and auditors. It aims to improve the quality and reliability of financial reporting and maintain investor confidence.

entry.title: SFC to implement enhancements to Hong Kong retail fund rules
entry.summary: SFC to proceed with enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime code SFC · Oct 8, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission will implement measures to strengthen the regime for SFC-authorised retail funds, taking effect in November 2026. The changes cover a Value-at-Risk approach for derivative exposure, streamlined requirements for management companies and feeder funds, and improved liquidity risk management and money market fund safeguards. Supplementary guidance, FAQs and revised templates will be published soon.

entry.title: Hong Kong securities brokers report strong H1 2026 earnings growth
entry.summary: Hong Kong’s securities brokers post strong earnings growth in first half of 2026 SFC · Oct 7, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission published its financial review of the securities industry for the first half of 2026. Net profit of securities dealers and securities margin financiers rose 21% half-on-half to HK$51.7 billion, with total transaction value reaching a record HK$149.0 trillion. Active clients rose 10% to about 5.7 million, while trading commission and interest income grew 13% and asset management fee income fell 21%.

entry.title: SFC and Malaysia's SC launch a single submission arrangement to simplify dual listings in Hong Kong and Malaysia
entry.summary: SFC, Securities Commission Malaysia announce Single Submission Arrangement to streamline simultaneous listings in Malaysia and Hong Kong SFC · Oct 1, 2026 The SFC and Securities Commission Malaysia announced simplified procedures for simultaneous listings in Hong Kong and Malaysia. Applicants can submit one listing application with one listing document to meet the requirements of both markets. Dedicated review teams at both regulators coordinate the process, and the SFC has issued a circular with related guidance published on both regulators' websites.

entry.title: SFC reprimands and fines Zheng Da $7 million, suspends its responsible officer for seven months
entry.summary: SFC reprimands and fines Zheng Da International Financial Holding Limited $7 million and suspends its responsible officer for regulatory breaches SFC · Sep 29, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission reprimanded and fined Zheng Da International Financial Holding Limited $7 million for AML/CFT and other regulatory failures between 1 December 2021 and 30 September 2023. It also suspended the licence of responsible officer Zhong Hao for seven months. The investigation found the firm conducted no due diligence or testing on customer supplied systems used by 160 clients and failed to detect suspicious trading patterns in client accounts.

entry.title: SFC updates industry on scam prevention and cybersecurity
entry.summary: SFC shares updates with securities industry on scam prevention and cybersecurity SFC · Sep 29, 2026 On 29 September 2026, the Securities and Futures Commission hosted a Brokers' Forum titled "Defend Your Business, Outsmart the Scammers" for more than 600 industry participants. The forum covered the latest supervisory observations and regulatory updates on cybersecurity and anti-scam measures. Speakers included the Hong Kong Police Force, IFEC, and industry representatives, who discussed emerging scam types and prevention approaches.

entry.title: SFC and AFRC sign new MoU extending financial reporting cooperation to licensed firms and funds
entry.summary: SFC and AFRC extend regulatory cooperation to financial reporting of licensed firms and funds under new MoU SFC · Sep 28, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Futures Commission and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council signed a new memorandum of understanding expanding their cooperation beyond listed entities. It covers financial and compliance reporting by licensed corporations, licensed virtual asset service providers, authorised funds and registered open-ended fund companies, along with related audit work. The MoU sets a framework for information sharing, case referrals, mutual assistance and coordinated inspections, and supersedes the 2021 agreement.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong at the signing ceremony of the SFC and AFRC memorandum of understanding
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at SFC and Accounting and Financial Reporting Council’s MoU Signing Ceremony SFC · Sep 28, 2026 SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong delivered remarks at the signing of a modernised memorandum of understanding between the SFC and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council. He traced the partnership back to 2007 and said the MoU supports Hong Kong's development as an international financial centre. The speech stresses that financial reporting and audit oversight are where both regulators' mandates meet, and that sharing intelligence and expertise will help detect risks earlier.

entry.title: SFC acts against suspected IPO-rigging groups and suspends trading in Baicha shares
entry.summary: SFC takes action against suspected IPO-rigging syndicates and suspends dealings in Baicha shares SFC · Oct 13, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission has taken action against two groups suspected of fraudulent schemes creating false demand for IPO shares. It directed the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong to suspend dealings in Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial shares (stock code 02555) from 9:00 am that day. Restriction notices were issued to brokers over client assets, and investigations are continuing.

entry.title: SFC notes sponsor progress and urges continued vigilance on IPO arrangements
entry.summary: SFC recognises progress in sponsors’ work and urges sustained vigilance SFC · Oct 13, 2026 The SFC issued a circular noting improvements in sponsors' resources and principal capacity since January. The share of active listing applications involving the five most active sponsors fell from 77% to 65% by September. It also flagged suspicious IPO arrangements and asked sponsors and other gatekeepers to watch for red flags.

entry.title: Speech by Dr Kelvin Wong at the IFAPC 25th anniversary and Outstanding Listed Companies Award 2026 ceremony
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at the IFAPC’s 25th anniversary and Outstanding Listed Companies Award 2026 SFC · Oct 16, 2026 The SFC published a speech by Dr Kelvin Wong at the 25th anniversary celebration of the Hong Kong Institute of Financial Analysts and Professional Commentators and the Outstanding Listed Companies Award 2026 ceremony (Chinese version only). The speech argues that analysts, listed companies and regulators jointly build market trust, identifies three pillars of research depth, independent judgement and continuous scrutiny, and stresses market quality for Hong Kong's competitiveness as an international financial centre.

entry.title: SFC welcomes HKEX proposal to move Hong Kong stock market to T+1 settlement
entry.summary: SFC welcomes HKEX’s proposal to implement T+1 settlement in Hong Kong’s stock market SFC · Oct 16, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission welcomes HKEX's October 16, 2026 consultation conclusions on moving Hong Kong's stock market from a T+2 to a T+1 settlement cycle. The implementation timeline has been revised to the second half of 2028, with September 2028 as the target date. The SFC will work with HKEX on the necessary amendments to rules and procedures for an orderly transition.

entry.title: SFC welcomes re-appointment of non-executive directors
entry.summary: SFC welcomes re-appointment of Non-Executive Directors SFC · Oct 16, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission welcomes the Financial Secretary's re-appointment of Keith Pogson and Chew Fook-aun as Non-Executive Directors for two-year terms starting 20 October 2026 and 1 January 2027, respectively. SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong said their experience and judgement have contributed greatly to the Board's work and the SFC's effective governance. He added that the Board will continue working to uphold market integrity and protect investors.

entry.title: SFC brings market misconduct tribunal case against GEM-listed Taste•Gourmet executives and associates over alleged share price manipulation tied to Main Board transfer
entry.summary: SFC commences MMT proceedings against GEM-listed Taste•Gourmet’s top executives and associates over alleged manipulation scheme for Main Board transfer SFC · Oct 22, 2026 The Securities and Futures Commission has started proceedings in the Market Misconduct Tribunal against three top executives of Taste•Gourmet Group Limited and five of their relatives, employees and associates. The SFC alleges they manipulated the company's share price from 1 June to 18 September 2020 to meet the minimum market capitalisation needed for a Main Board transfer. The tribunal will decide whether market misconduct occurred and who was involved.

entry.title: Hong Kong SFC approves first secondary trading of tokenised public funds
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The SFC approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform. Two existing SFC-authorised tokenised money market funds can now be traded around the clock. The SFC set out requirements and safeguards for such trading in an April 2026 circular, covering the trading channel, fair pricing, liquidity provision and disclosure.

entry.title: HKSAR Government's fourth digital green bond offering
entry.summary: HKSAR Government’s Fourth Digital Green Bonds Offering HKMA · Sep 29, 2026 · Crypto The HKSAR Government priced about HK$20 billion of digital green bonds in HKD, RMB, USD and EUR under its Government Sustainable Bond Programme. The offering was oversubscribed, with subscription ratios of 1.3 to 11.3 times across the four currencies. The HKD tranche settled using tokenised deposits, which the release describes as a world first for a digital bond.
